description: The scenes both rigs draw from the fixtures, by the same names: tests/parity/desktop.py for Baude, android/.../screenshots/Parity.kt for the phone. chat scenes open fixtures/sessions.json's first session with only the first `lines` lines of its transcript (all of them when absent), or of the fixture named by `transcript` instead; `files` names a folder of fixtures/ whose contents join the chat's folder; `open` opens every tool call's input and output where the app can. `inventory` names the schema/ui entries the scene shows.

scenes.name: home
scenes.what: The sessions list, no chat open

scenes.name: home-row-menu
scenes.what: The sessions list, the first session's menu open (right-click on the desktop, a long-press on the phone)

scenes.name: home-host-menu
scenes.what: The sessions list, the host picker's menu open (right-click or press and hold)

scenes.name: home-add-host
scenes.what: Add a host, from the host picker's menu

scenes.name: chat-bash
scenes.what: A failed command with its output, after thinking

scenes.name: chat-bash-open
scenes.what: The same, its input and output opened

scenes.name: chat-read-search
scenes.what: Read, Grep and Glob in a row

scenes.name: chat-read-search-open
scenes.what: The same, opened

scenes.name: chat-markdown
scenes.what: A reply with bold, a table and a code block

scenes.name: chat-gallery-text
scenes.what: A message of yours with a picture and markdown, thinking, then headings, emphasis, nested lists, a quote and a rule

scenes.name: chat-gallery-links
scenes.what: Every kind of link, and an image from the chat's folder

scenes.name: chat-gallery-table
scenes.what: A wide table with long cells

scenes.name: chat-gallery-code
scenes.what: A bash block and a code block taller than two thirds of the chat

scenes.name: chat-edit-write
scenes.what: An Edit (a diff) and a Write (a file)

scenes.name: chat-edit-write-open
scenes.what: The same, opened

scenes.name: chat-todo-agent
scenes.what: TodoWrite and a subagent (Task)

scenes.name: chat-todo-agent-open
scenes.what: The same, opened

scenes.name: chat-web-mcp
scenes.what: WebFetch and an MCP tool

scenes.name: chat-web-mcp-open
scenes.what: The same, opened

scenes.name: chat-end
scenes.what: The whole chat, at its end

scenes.name: menu
scenes.what: The chat's main menu open (☰ on the desktop)

scenes.name: settings
scenes.what: Settings

scenes.name: changelog
scenes.what: The changelog of the running version

scenes.name: panel-meta
